set.rules:
I — Tap up to one target creature an opponent controls.
II — Up to one target creature you control gains ward {2} until your next turn.
III — Exile up to one target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
set.flavorMatchRationale: Hybrid redesign: obstruct pursuit, preserve the hidden guest, then return the creature as itself. All three chapters use white-blue overlap; the Saga does not grant blue-only unblockability to white.

set.mechanics: Saga; Hybrid; rummage; spell recursion; cost reduction
set.rules:
I — You may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
II — Return up to one target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
III — The next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn costs {2} less to cast.
set.flavorMatchRationale: Hybrid redesign: sift the plan, recover a stratagem, then execute it at reduced cost. Rummaging, instant/sorcery recursion, and spell cost reduction are shared blue-red space; no blue-only tapping or unrestricted red card draw.

set.mechanics: Saga; Hybrid; Treasure; sacrifice; tokens; menace
set.rules:
I — Create a Treasure token.
II — You may sacrifice an artifact or creature. If you do, create two 1/1 black and red Human Sailor creature tokens.
III — Creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain menace until end of turn.
set.flavorMatchRationale: Hybrid redesign: acquire supplies, spend a shared resource to assemble the dissenting crew, then attack. Treasure, sacrifice, small creature tokens, a temporary power boost, and menace support either black or red without hybrid card-draw leakage.

set.mechanics: Saga; Hybrid; mill; graveyard exile; creature recursion
set.rules:
I — Mill three cards.
II — Exile up to one target card from a graveyard. You gain 2 life.
III — Return up to one target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
set.flavorMatchRationale: Hybrid redesign: prepare the graveyard, mark a passage from it, and recover one creature as knowledge brought back. Both black and green support this sequence; optional targets keep later chapters useful when graveyards change.

set.mechanics: Saga; Hybrid; household tokens; life gain; counters; vigilance
set.rules:
I — Create two 1/1 green and white Human creature tokens.
II — You gain 3 life.
III — Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures you control. Those creatures gain vigilance until end of turn.
set.flavorMatchRationale: Hybrid redesign: establish the household, sustain it, then strengthen its defenders. Creature tokens, life gain, counters, and vigilance work in either green or white; unrestricted permanent reanimation has been removed.

set.rules:
When Calypso's Orchard enters, create a Food token.
Constellation — Whenever an enchantment enters under your control, untap up to one target creature you control. That creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn. This ability triggers only once each turn.
set.flavorMatchRationale: The singular orchard is a rare legendary place: its arrival supplies Food and recurring enchantments refresh a creature. This provides one compensating legendary slot when the Oath becomes a nonlegendary hybrid Saga, without adding a card or altering artwork.

authority: Targeted mainset-cycles-v1 sheet pass, followed by the user’s song-Saga direction and live-release authorization on 19 September 2026. Card names are original working design titles, not quotations.

songs.title: Lay of the Hidden King
songs.setting: A song about Odysseus returning to his own household in disguise (Books XIII–XVII).

interpretations.W: Patience and restraint protect a household until its rightful order can be restored.
interpretations.U: Concealment, observation and the right moment let intelligence overcome superior numbers.

songs.title: Song of the Wooden Horse
songs.setting: A song of the wooden horse and the fall of Troy, recalling the subject sung by Demodocus at Scheria (Book VIII).

interpretations.U: A patient stratagem can achieve what a long siege could not.
interpretations.R: Daring and decisive action break a seemingly endless war.

songs.title: Song of the Faithless Crew
songs.setting: A cautionary song about the crew’s fatal choices, especially Eurylochus and the cattle of Helios (Book XII).

interpretations.B: Survival and self-interest can become excuses for sacrificing what must be preserved.
interpretations.R: Shared hunger and anger can make a crew defy its leader and act together.

songs.title: Lament at the Blood-Trench
songs.setting: A lament retelling the encounter with the shades at the blood-trench (Book XI).

interpretations.B: The dead still have a price and something the living need.
interpretations.G: Remembering mortality and ancestry restores perspective to the living.

songs.title: Song of the Faithful Queen
songs.setting: A song about Penelope preserving the household through the long absence and homecoming (Books I–XXIII).

interpretations.G: Endurance and care allow a household to live and grow.
interpretations.W: Fidelity and shared responsibility hold a community together.
